query: So what can you do if the cops did something wrong?
reference_answer:
Legal Remedies for Police Misconduct:
In Tamil Nadu, you can file a complaint with the State Human Rights Commission or the National Human Rights Commission. You can also approach the Superintendent of Police or the District Collector. Additionally, you can file a writ petition in the High Court or a complaint under Section 154 of the CrPC.
answer: If the police have done something wrong, you can file a complaint with their department or a civilian review board. You might also seek legal advice to understand your rights and options. [Document 1]
